$3 million scratch-off ticket sold in Heidelberg Township

by LebTown Staff July 22, 2026July 22, 2026 < 1 min read
EN
CommentsFacebookEmailShare

You can help LebTown grow. If you rely on us for your Lebanon County news, now is the time to join as a member. Join the 1,000+ LebTown readers who support our work as members.

Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:12
Instaread

The Pennsylvania Lottery announced that the Speedway at 1082 Heidelberg Ave. in Heidelberg Township sold a winning Mega Moolah Multiplier scratch-off ticket worth $3 million.

Don't miss LebTown's next scoop.

Get our free weekly email newsletter.

The retailer will receive a $10,000 bonus for selling the top-prize ticket.

The Mega Moolah Multiplier is a $30 game offering top prizes of $3 million.

Scratch-Offs are distributed at random, meaning the lottery does not know where winning tickets will be sold and learns where winning tickets are sold only after a prize is claimed.
